title: Three-component synthesis of β-sulfonyl enamines and dienamines enabled by silver(I) acetate
content:

The three-component synthesis of β-sulfonyl enamines and δ-sulfonyl dienamines is achieved by silver acetate-mediated condensation of secondary and tertiary amines with sodium sulfinates.
